definition: Today's documented research behind Tether Transport Networks.

Autonomous shipping trials (Yara Birkeland, MAS) test crewless cargo vessels. Together these programs form the tether stations foundation that Tether Transport Networks will build on — the network logistics results, the spin control methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as network logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Tether Transport Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Tether Transport Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Tether Transport Networks — momentum tethers tossing payloads between orbits.

Phase 1 — Prove (tether stations): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spin control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (catch mechanisms): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
